name: Wei Zhang
bio:
Wei Zhang's motorsport journey began unexpectedly. Originally trained as an engineer, he found himself drawn to the strategic complexities of racing through a chance encounter with a small Formula 3 team. He quickly realized his analytical skills and ability to foresee potential outcomes were perfectly suited for the role of strategist. Wei's approach is meticulous and data-driven, leaving no stone unturned in his quest for the optimal race strategy.

He joined Eurofarma RC after several successful seasons with smaller teams, drawn by their ambition and willingness to embrace innovative approaches. Wei is known for his demanding nature, pushing his team to achieve perfection. He believes that the smallest details can make the difference between victory and defeat. His experience and unwavering commitment make him a valuable asset to any team looking for a competitive edge.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed back with a slight wave
physical.description: Wei is of average height and build, with a perpetually serious expression.

quirks: Always carries a worn abacus for quick calculations.
Insists on drinking jasmine tea before every race.
Taps his pen rhythmically when deep in thought.
